Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Glen Rice?

Glen Rice is 59 years old.

Where was Glen Rice born?

Glen Rice was born in Jacksonville, Arkansas.

When was Glen Rice born?

Glen Rice was born on May 28, 1967.

How tall is Glen Rice?

Glen Rice is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much did Glen Rice weigh when playing?

Glen Rice weighed 215 lbs (97 kg) when playing.

Is Glen Rice in the Hall of Fame?

Glen Rice is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Glen Rice drafted?

Glen Rice was drafted by Miami Heat, 1st round (4th pick, 4th overall), 1989 NBA Draft.

What position did Glen Rice play?

Small Forward.

When did Glen Rice retire?

Glen Rice last played in 2004.

What is Glen Rice's net worth?

Glen Rice made at least $68,323,900 playing professional basketball.

How much did Glen Rice make?

Glen Rice made $9,200,000 in 2003.

What did Glen Rice average?

Glen Rice averaged 18.3 points, 4.4 rebounds, and 2.1 assists per game.

How many rings does Glen Rice have?

Glen Rice won one championship.

What schools did Glen Rice attend?

Glen Rice attended Flint Northwestern in Flint, Michigan and Michigan.

What are Glen Rice's nicknames?

G Money, G are nicknames for Glen Rice.
